scope_disclaimer: This verification report provides automated empirical testing and static route analysis of core architectural invariants across platform code paths. It is rigorous automated assurance, but does not constitute a formal mathematical proof (e.g., TLA+ or Coq machine proof).

checks.name: Viewer Actuation Guard
checks.details: Tested 3 actuator endpoints against role VIEWER; all returned 403 Forbidden.

checks.name: Operator Resolution Guard
checks.details: Verified that both permission matrix and OperatorWorkflow reject OPERATOR resolution with PermissionDenied.

checks.name: Commander Action Non-Repudiation
checks.details: Verified all Commander lifecycle transitions (confirm, escalate, acknowledge, resolve) are written to operator_actions ledger.

checks.name: Manual Emergency Dispatch Gate
checks.details: Verified decision engines only synthesize recommendations; physical dispatch requires human Commander escalation.

checks.name: Model Registry Restriction Gate
checks.details: Verified status (PRODUCTION / CANDIDATE / RESEARCH_ONLY) strictly enforced at actuation boundary.

checks.name: Closed Incident Immutability
checks.details: Verified that CLOSED incidents strictly reject all transitions (acknowledge, confirm, escalate, resolve, false_alarm).

checks.name: Critical Incident Retention Protection
checks.details: Verified that active/unresolved critical incidents and linked evidence are strictly protected from retention pruning.

checks.name: Sensor Failure Confidence Monotonicity
checks.details: Property test: Degraded health inputs (camera, audio, sensors) and sensor disagreement monotonically decrease risk.
